notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm actively working on a Switch port at the moment but I'm not forgetting about you, the Steam players! I've been wanting to add a solo training mode for a while, and I'm finally working on it.

notes.title: Dashpong winter update
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's officially winter and so I thought bringing a small winter update to Dashpong would be cool ❄️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/e41ebf2746ddab68740d16ca401ef36326732652.jpg[/img]

I've added a new Ice map and a new special mode called Gifts. In this mode, Santa crosses the map and drops gift. When you open the gift by dashing on it, you can either freeze the enemy, freeze your own goal (as a protection) or freeze the opponent's side, making it slippery. What comes out of the gift is random and applies automatically. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/730e7461f121eac85237de3938e030bb03e77c9e.png[/img]

I've also added a new dynamic camera option! It's enabled by default but you can switch back to the static camera at anytime by toggling it off in the settings. I personnaly really like the new camera, it feels like you're in the game more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/81d2a83e1d30fda9644174089fb5f6ea9436f887.gif[/img]

I hope you'll enjoy this small update, and see you tomorrow for the Winter Sales! 🤑

Byyye 👋

notes.title: Dashpong releases next week! Devlog #10
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Dashpong releases next week ([b]October 28th[/b]) and I'm super excited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/b72f280974bebf77422fc67b845c7c472b455431.gif[/img]

I made a new devlog talking about my preparation for release, how I decided on a release date, etc.. If you want to jump straight to the video, click below! 

[previewyoutube=-azLB8Brzas;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm not going to lie, deciding on a release date was not an easy task. I've been struggling to work on Dashpong for a few weeks now, and I was starting to hate the game. 

During development, I had a lots of ideas for the game. I wanted to add many things, I was really excited. When I decided to release the game, I had to face reality and decide what features should be kept or not. 

I don't want you to buy the game thinking things will be there and then be disappointed because they're not. Let me get straight to the point:
[b]I decided to remove the tournament mode, the solo training mode and AI opponents.[/b]

It doesn't mean they're gone forever, and for example I know that AI opponents can be really useful, so I'm probably going to work on it for a future update. 

At release, you'll have the classic mode, the arcade mode with all the special modes and a custom mode to select various things: player size, speed, duration, etc.. Of course you can still play up to 4 people and even in asymmetry (2v1 or 3v1). 

I have updates planned for Dashpong, with new maps, new game modes, so stay tuned for that! 

Thanks everyone for your support, see you at release :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/8812612042ce6fa380b772c0df08ee9fb01cb382.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dashpong demo update & small devlog
notes.content:
Hey guys 👋, 
it's been a long time since my last devlog, and I wanted to write a few words before doing my next video about Dashpong! Development has been going really well, and I just updated the demo. So, if you just want to play, download the latest build and enjoy ;)


I don't think I'll be able to list everything that happened since the last devlog, but here we go!

[h2]Special modes[/h2]

I've added lots of special modes, like rewind, multiple balls, gravity wells, world gravity, special balls, and much more! We are approaching 30 special modes, and I still have some ideas. I think I'll soon stop implementing more and make sure everything is stable and enjoyable to play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/2808f5d5d6aff433f242e66147655697850372de.gif[/img]

[h2]New maps[/h2]

I've created two new maps: Reversed and Pointy (name are temporary, if you have better ideas, please let me know!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/ef518eb1195dc03a81d386c01dd8c584be9d0c4b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/55ed76b7644974991e8e6149ff9f092757cd36d1.png[/img]

[h2]QOL & bug fixes[/h2]

I've added lots of quality of life features and small bug fixes. You can now select "random" when choosing a map. This will choose a map for you, and will change it at every new game. You can also start a game in asymmetry: 2V1, 3V1, you choose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/c713f70771ed88bf5aae013852aac3ed3bbdd2b2.png[/img]

[h2]Audio[/h2]

I'm always adding more sound effects, thanks to my collab with [url=https://www.audiopad.store]Audiopad[/url]. At the moment we're working on the ones for the special modes, and there's a lot to do!

[h2]General[/h2]

[h3]In game messages[/h3]

I've added two ways of displaying messages in game:
- The first one is when someone scores. Depending on the score difference, or if you're on a streak or many other possibilities, it will display a message with the score, such as: DOMINATING, SCORING SPREE, etc... I think this is a cool way to make scoring even more interesting. 
- The other one is when you save the ball or shoot on goal. If you manage to stop the ball with your character in front of a goal, you'll see a message like: "SAVE" or "EPIC SAVE". If you shoot on goal but something blocks the shot (like a paddle), you'll see: "SHOT ON GOAL". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/88599119b66bbb5ac9bb859affe1bd88e0301fc3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/9d3c8ec00568dd6eaf08e1b80a3a24a359b56fbd.png[/img]

[h3]Goal replay[/h3]

I'm working on a very cool feature: goal replay. Just like in Rocket League (a great inspiration for Dashpong), you'll see a replay of the goal after the scoring animation. Of course, it's skippable and you can deactivate it completely in the settings. 

This doesn't mean that the replays are saved! This is another feature I'd love to implement, but right now I'm stuck because Godot takes too much time to give me the viewport texture each frame. This is hurting performance, so unless it gets better with the next Godot update or if I find another solution, I can't do it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/e57ddd14f57346af257e5c89f8f4032dbaee6e7f.png[/img]

[h3]Awards & stuff[/h3]

On an another subject, I got nominated for the [url=https://www.mooneyestudios.com/colorsofindie]Colors of Indie][/url] award! I didn't win, but I'm very proud of having being selected. I had to pitch my game in front of 3 people from Mooneye studio and this was a great experience. I'm going to try more award things like this and game conventions in the next weeks/months. I think this can be a great way to let people know about Dashpong.

And I think that's it! There's probably way more stuff but I tend to forget as I'm adding so many things in Dashpong.. oops

I hope you enjoyed this little text devlog. I'll make a video devlog soon, talking about the rewind mechanic, as it was a pretty interesting one to create. 

If you want to see more Dashpong stuff, I'm live pretty much everyday on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mreliptik]Twitch][/url]. Follow me there and drop by to say hi!

Byyye!
👋

notes.title: Devlog #7, full redesign & new special modes!
notes.content:
Hey guys, Dashpong devlog 7 is here!🎉

In this devlog, I'm showing you everything that I redesigned: all maps, the in game animations & the UI and also the progress I've made on special modes.

The redesign went really well and I'm super excited for the new look. I feel very confident now and designing more content is easier than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/18846a5d83d4c17ed36f4a9f4f99a785acf26c82.gif[/img]

In terms of special mode, I already have more than 10 implemented in the game, that I'll be playtesting soon. I'm always adding more and I'm open to suggestions! So, if you have one (or more!) drop them in the comments 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41104956/b4962509ca7330ab4b48d9ced31d25be3776e67d.jpg[/img]

I've already started upgrading the visuals on this page and on Steam, but I still have some work with the GIFs and a new trailer! Also, I'll soon update the demo, that way you'll be able to experience the new visuals and some special modes!

I'm really excited for the future of Dashpong, and I hope you are too!

Byyye 👋

notes.title: Dashpong demo is out!
notes.content:
The Steam Next Fest has officially started, and you can try the Dashpong demo! 

Enjoy the game solo with the training mode or with friends (up to 4 players!).

There might be an issue if the controller vibration is set to [b]none [/b](the game crashes). If that's the case, go in the game's settings and make sure controller vibration is either soft or normal!
